milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the brown terracotta wall (at spawn-relative x=2, y=1.5, z=0) and face it. The wall is a prominent landmark 2 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=8 is generous enough to trigger when the player can clearly see it, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate past the brown terracotta wall and get close to the polished diorite stairs (centered at spawn-relative x=5, y=1, z=0). max_distance=5 ensures the player has moved past the wall (at x=2) and is near the stairs (at x=4-6). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because this is a 'mine' task — when red terracotta is mined, it drops itself as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no red_terracotta, so min_count=1 confirms at least one block was successfully mined from the elevated platform. An iron pickaxe is provided in the scene for efficient mining.
